import json
from pathlib import Path
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
def add(start,calls,flags=None,extras=None):
 p=Path('answers.jsonl')
 out=[] if start==1 else [json.loads(x) for x in p.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert len(out)==start-1
 for j,cs in enumerate(calls.split()):
  it=items[start-1+j]
  assert len(cs)==it['slots']
  out.append(dict(item_id=it['item_id'],slots={str(k+1):c for k,c in enumerate(cs)},confidence={str(k+1):'high' for k in range(len(cs))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=(extras or {}).get(j,[]),pre1918=(flags or {}).get(j,'yes'),note=''))
 p.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in out))
